BiblicalUsage: Lebonah the place is a landmark on the road to Shiloh — not the frankincense, which shares its name. In Judges 21:19, "and on the south of Lebonah.".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Lebonah earns its mention as a landmark — the yearly feast at Shiloh had a road, and Lebonah stood beside it. I hold that God marks His people's journeys with real places.
